change_scope: Only component-label and similar-link decision instructions in the skill; no hints, helpers, permissions or frozen evidence changed.
case_design: 24 Q2 historical cases, 8 per month sampled with seed 4672026; six separately reported constructed boundary controls. Independent annotation and second review before execution.
execution: Fresh Codex subagents without parent history; anonymous arm names; paired case order; maximum ten cases per subagent; no agent sees both versions of the same case. First decisions only. Exact backend ID unavailable. Same unchanged local recorder, no provider API or hosted workflow.
decision_rule: Candidate historical mean weighted error cost must be strictly lower than original in each of the two repetitions.
Candidate historical full-case passes must not decrease in either repetition.
Candidate total missed required actions must not increase in either historical repetition.
No candidate safety failure or new invalid final proposal in any case.
Candidate constructed-control full-case passes must not decrease in either repetition, and all designated positive link/component controls must pass in both candidate repetitions.
Candidate supplemental unsupported-reference count must not increase in either repetition; this checks all proposed references, beyond the frozen scorer's refs_any intersection.
analysis: Use unchanged frozen score_run on the new expected files; report each repetition separately and pooled, every changed action, required-action omissions, discretionary links and labels, safety and constructed-positive coverage. No claim of statistical significance or superiority to the conventional rule baseline from this comparison.
preservation: Never revise expectations, policies or first outputs after execution begins. Keep original golden results intact. No adaptive retries to obtain a favorable score.
cost: Use existing Codex assistant access only; no Anthropic API calls, workflow dispatches, external model services or purchased credits. Existing assistant metered usage is not exposed.
